fields.name: Privacy_Script_Text
fields.fieldText:
In order to assist you further, we need to collect some personal details such as your name and contact details from you. ANZ uses the information provided by you to respond to your query which may not be possible without these details.


Your personal information will not be disclosed outside the ANZ group (which may include our contact centres located overseas). 


ANZ's Privacy Policy explains how ANZ handles personal information and explains how you may access and seek correction of the information ANZ holds about you or raise a concern about how ANZ has handled your information.


For a copy of ANZ’s privacy policy please visit www.anz.com.au/privacy

fields.name: Privacy_Script_2_Text
fields.fieldText:
ANZ supports your decision to remain anonymous and appreciates your feedback.

 __ 

Just so you know, complaints made anonymously or using a pseudonym may limit our ability to manage some complaints effectively and may mean we can only provide a generic response.
